title: National Health Mission (NHM) – Key Highlights:
summary: National Health Mission (NHM) – Key Highlights: — Flagship scheme comprehensively covered in the Government Schemes Consolidated Masterfile.

blocks.title: 🏛️ Canonical Reference & Masterfile Integration
blocks.text: This flagship scheme is comprehensively detailed in the Government Schemes Masterfile (Section: "migrated-schemes-masterfile"). Key highlights and parameters are summarized below.

items:  Reduce MMR to 1/1000 live births, IMR to 25/1000 live births
 Prevent and control communicable and non-communicable diseases
 Maternal and child health, immunization, disease control, workforce strengthening
 Joint funding by central and state governments
